proposal.tubing_material: FEP (fluorinated ethylene propylene, UV/Vis transparent, chemically inert to MeCN and O2)
proposal.residence_time_basis: Total in-channel volumetric flow (liquid + pressure-compressed gas) divided into fixed reactor volume; BPR back-pressure reduces gas volume per ideal-gas compression from atmospheric injection pressure to operating pressure.
proposal.light_setup: 420 nm high-power LED array (approx. 36 W total, multiple LEDs) wrapped concentrically around the FEP coil to mimic the single 1.5 W batch LED but scaled for larger irradiated surface area; coil diameter chosen to maintain uniform path length to LEDs (~1 cm).

streams.pump_role: Primary liquid feed (HPLC or syringe pump)
Gas feed via mass flow controller (MFC)
streams.contents: Compressed air (used as O2 source, ~21% O2)
streams.molar_equiv: ~5x stoichiometric O2 (based on 1:1 O2:substrate for sulfoxide formation)

proposal.mixer_type: PEEK T-mixer generating Taylor (segmented) gas-liquid flow immediately upstream of the photoreactor coil
proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Substrate and photocatalyst are pre-mixed homogeneously in one liquid stream since the sensitizer is soluble and non-reactive in the dark; gas is introduced only at the mixer inlet to initiate immediate segmented flow, maximizing gas-liquid interfacial area for singlet-oxygen generation and mass transfer once irradiation begins.
pre_reactor_steps: Dissolve Fmoc-Met and photocatalyst together in MeCN, 0.10 M/0.010 M respectively, degas briefly is NOT required (air/O2 must remain present).
Filter solution (0.2 micron) to prevent particulate blockage of narrow-bore tubing.
Set MFC to deliver 5.0 sccm air feed to T-mixer for segmented flow generation.
post_reactor_steps: In-line back-pressure regulator (5.0 bar) to maintain compressed gas segments and prevent premature gas expansion/bubble coalescence.
Gas-liquid membrane separator to vent excess unreacted air/O2 to a fume hood exhaust.
Collect degassed reaction stream; concentrate in vacuo or directly analyze by HPLC for sulfoxide purity/yield.
proposal.chemistry_notes: 4,7-Diphenyl-2,1,3-benzothiadiazole acts as a visible-light photosensitizer, absorbing 420 nm light to reach a triplet excited state that transfers energy to ground-state triplet O2, generating singlet oxygen (1O2). This electrophilic oxidant reacts selectively with the nucleophilic thioether sulfur of methionine to form a transient persulfoxide, which collapses to the sulfoxide product without over-oxidation to sulfone under short residence times. The flow-adapted process replaces static air headspace with continuous gas-liquid segmented flow, which dramatically improves O2 mass transfer relative to batch stirring, allowing full conversion within a comparable residence time despite lower catalyst loading efficiency per pass.

Stage_1_Mixing.description: Combine liquid substrate/catalyst stream with metered air stream to form Taylor flow segments.

Stage_2_Photoreaction.description: Irradiate segmented flow through FEP coil surrounded by 420 nm LEDs; singlet oxygen generated in situ oxidizes methionine to sulfoxide.

Stage_3_BPR_and_Separation.description: Maintain elevated pressure to compress gas segments (improving O2 solubility/transfer) then separate unreacted gas via membrane separator before collection.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Matches original batch photoreaction time (5 min) under equivalent photon flux density; verified via reactor volume/flow rate consistency check.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Total in-channel flow (liquid + compressed gas) computed as 1.0 mL/min liquid + ~1.01 mL/min compressed air = 2.01 mL/min, giving residence time of ~5 min in a 10 mL reactor.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Directly carried over from batch protocol (21 C, ambient/near-RT reaction, no exotherm expected for photocatalytic oxidation).
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Same substrate concentration as batch (0.10 M) to preserve photon absorption path length and catalyst turnover kinetics.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: 5.0 bar back-pressure selected to compress the air segments (from atmospheric injection) enough to achieve near-parity with batch dissolved-oxygen levels, while remaining well within FEP tubing pressure limits (typically rated to 10-17 bar).
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Gas-liquid segmented (Taylor) flow was chosen because the batch reaction relies on ambient air dissolution during stirring; segmented flow is the standard method to replicate/enhance this mass transfer continuously.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP is standard for photoflow chemistry due to UV-Vis transparency at 420 nm and compatibility with MeCN and O2.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm ID balances gas segment formation, back-pressure requirements, and reasonable coil length for a 10 mL reactor.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: 10 mL selected to yield ~5 min residence at a practical combined flow rate, consistent with batch photoreaction duration.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: Scaled-up 420 nm LED wrap-around array to deliver comparable (or higher) photon flux per unit volume as the single 1.5 W batch LED, compensating for larger reactor surface area in flow.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_sccm: 5.0 sccm air chosen to provide a large stoichiometric excess of O2 (~5x) ensuring the reaction is not O2-limited, mirroring excess ambient air availability in the open batch flask.
reasoning_per_field.gas_flow_actual_mL_min: Calculated via ideal gas law compression from atmospheric injection pressure (~1.013 bar) to system operating pressure (5.0 bar) under the fixed BPR.

literature_analogies: Noel and coworkers (Eindhoven) demonstrated continuous-flow generation of singlet oxygen using photosensitizers in FEP coil reactors under LED irradiation for allylic oxidation and Diels-Alder trapping reactions, employing similar gas-liquid segmented flow with O2/air.
Corning Advanced-Flow Reactor (AFR) photochemistry platforms have been used for aerobic thioether oxidations analogous to methionine sulfoxidation, employing controlled O2 partial pressure via BPR.

Vapourtec UV-150 photoreactor studies on Rose Bengal- or methylene blue-sensitized singlet oxygen reactions provide direct precedent for matching batch LED photon flux to flow coil surface-to-volume ratios.
safety_flags: Acetonitrile is flammable; ensure all electrical/LED components are rated for solvent-compatible environments and located away from ignition sources.
Compressed air introduces an oxidizer-rich environment; verify gas separator vents to a fume hood to prevent local O2 enrichment.
Photocatalyst and any triplet-sensitized side products should be evaluated for photostability; monitor for extended irradiation causing sulfone over-oxidation.
System pressure (5 bar) must remain below FEP tubing and fitting ratings; use rated PEEK/FEP fittings and pressure relief on the BPR line.
LED arrays emit intense 420 nm light; use enclosure or UV-blocking safety glasses to protect operators from direct/scattered exposure.
